name: keepa_product
description: Price & sales-rank history + stats for an Amazon ASIN — the historical low/high/avg, current Amazon/New/Used/Buy-Box prices, sales rank, and est. monthly units sold. Example: keepa_product({ asin: "B08N5WRWNW", domain: 1, _apiKey: "your-key" })

stats_days.description: Compute stats over the last N days (default 90).

_apiKey.description: Keepa API key (64-char hex; subscribe at keepa.com)

name: keepa_bestsellers
description: Bestsellers in an Amazon category — returns the top ASINs by sales rank for a given category node id. Example: keepa_bestsellers({ category: "281052", domain: 1, _apiKey: "your-key" })

category.description: Amazon category node id (e.g. "281052"). Use keepa_product on a known ASIN to find its sales_rank_reference category.

domain.description: Keepa marketplace id (default 1=US). See keepa_product for the full list.

name: keepa_deals
description: Current Amazon deals — recent price drops across the marketplace, optionally filtered to a minimum % off. Example: keepa_deals({ domain: 1, min_percent_off: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

domain.description: Keepa marketplace id (default 1=US). See keepa_product for the full list.

selection.description: Advanced: a full Keepa deals "selection" object to send verbatim (overrides the simple filters). See keepa.com API docs for its schema.

name: keepa_search
description: Search Amazon for a keyword → ASINs. Returns matching product ASINs (and titles when available) for a search term. Example: keepa_search({ term: "mechanical keyboard", domain: 1, _apiKey: "your-key" })

domain.description: Keepa marketplace id (default 1=US). See keepa_product for the full list.
